sheets.prompt: Transparent pixel-art source sheet for Glimway map lamps: exactly two front-facing compact lamp-head icons, left lit and right dimming, equal horizontal cells. Squat iron caps and glass, warm amber flame; dimming has the same silhouette, a low smaller flame, mostly dark glass, slightly more orange. Fill most of a 64x64 cell with 1-2 texels clear margin, readable at 16x16. Crisp stepped clusters, strong dark warm-brown outline, upper-left light, no antialiasing, blur or gradients; no disc, background, post, footing, text or extra objects.

Transparent source strip for a Glimway relit stone loop: three distinct silhouettes of a large bright warm-amber flame, flame only. Broad aligned bases, tapered tall flame sized to fill a narrow 12x24-pixel niche; tips lean and shift visibly between frames. Crisp stepped pixel clusters, 1-pixel dark warm-brown outline, saturated amber-orange body, bright golden core and small pale-gold highlight, upper-left light. No stone, wick, holder, external glow, smoke, text or other objects.

build: build_pass.py fits the transparent generated cell crops with nearest-neighbour sampling, composites the three flames over the unchanged canonical dark stone, and records source rectangles, canvases, anchors, atlas frames and loop metadata.
